Definition: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
BiblicalUsage: Man, mankind — adam is the word for the human creature. "Let us make man in our image, after our likeness"; "the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life"; and David asks, "What is man, that thou art mindful of him?" The word holds both the dust and the image in one breath.
TheologicalSignificance: We are dust, and we are image-bearers — I hold both together, because the Bible does. The dust keeps us humble; the image keeps us from despair. Man is small, and yet God is mindful of him.
